notes.title: Upcoming Conquest update news
notes.notes:
With the v6.0.0 update comes the long awaited Conquest update to Tap Ninja!
Embark on establishing your settlement and conquering the enemy provinces while earning varying rewards from your spoils.

[h2]Build it[/h2]
On this new island you will be tasked with constructing multiple buildings to help in your conquest efforts. Some of the buildings include:
[list]
[*] Castle - your main bastion, advancing rest of the buildings
[*] School - a place to study new technologies through different branches
[*] Tavern - the hangout where heroes meet for new adventures
[/list]

Each of these buildings can be levelled up, improving their effects. Be wary that gold is no good in constructing lasting buildings, so materials of [b]Lumber[/b] and [b]Ore[/b] will have to be harvested for their use in constructing these buildings.

[url=https://i.imgur.com/YvNoNFI.png][img]https://i.imgur.com/YvNoNFI.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Conquer it[/h2]
The island is covered with enemy [b]Provinces[/b] and [b]Towns[/b] within, your job is to conquer them all. Each of the town's levels will award you with multiple rewards while conquering the whole province will award you with a more substantial reward which can include a boost to your Ninjas Elixir income, award more daily currency or even unlock another daily Quest slot.

[url=https://i.imgur.com/jNeYqiy.png][img]https://i.imgur.com/jNeYqiy.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Heroes assemble[/h2]
How do you conquer these towns? Your ninja can’t do it all alone, so [b]Heroes[/b] have to be recruited for aid in this task. Recruiting happens with [b]Scrolls[/b] similarly to how Pet summoning works.

Heroes come in many shapes and sizes, so each hero is divided into a [b]class[/b], a [b]faction[/b] and a [b]rarity[/b].
[list]
[*] The class determines what the hero's role on the field is with the available classes being a Warrior, a Mage, an Assassin & Support.
[*] The faction determines its strength and weakness against corresponding factions, the factions being Fire, Wind, Earth & Water.
[*] The rarity shows how many skills the hero has. Rare only has an Ultimate, Epic has an Ultimate and a passive while Legendary has an Ultimate and two passives.
[/list]

The heroes battlefield strength is determined by its [b]Star level[/b] and [b]Hero level[/b] with the Star level being gained during the recruitment (which can be upgraded afterwards). The Hero level on the other hand uses [b]Hero Exp[/b], which is gained through conquering towns and passively from the Training Grounds building.

[url=https://i.imgur.com/eMzafbR.png][img]https://i.imgur.com/eMzafbR.png[/img][/url]

[h2]What of my ninja?[/h2]
The base game is not forgotten and is receiving multiple updates including:
[list]
[*] Upgrade Tier 15
[*] New Ascension skills
[*] New achievements
[*] 3 new pets
[*] Unlockable tints for each pet and their skins
[*] And more!
[/list]

[url=https://i.imgur.com/iRGxWQK.png][img]https://i.imgur.com/iRGxWQK.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Now what?[/h2]
The update is big and comparable to a new side game being added to Tap Ninja, but the work on it is going very well and a public beta test will be available on Steam for everyone in around 24 days with the full release of the update coming roughly two weeks afterwards, if no delays occur.

Each day leading to the beta test will have a small tease about each of the upcoming heroes, so keep following for more updates in this post - https://steamcommunity.com/app/1891700/discussions/0/4361249719396183109/

notes.title: v5.1.0 update news & Beta test
notes.notes:
[h1]v5.1.0 has landed on the public beta test![/h1]
Anyone that is playing on a Steam client can join. Read the instructions on how to join over here - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1891700/discussions/0/3316358999124492855/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/1891700/discussions/0/3316358999124492855/[/url]

[i]Your main games save file will not be affected while playing the beta, and the beta save file will be deleted once the beta ends.[/i]



[h2]More medals - more fun[/h2]
To fight the Medal drought the Challenge Upgrade Track has been implemented - by simply completing Weekly Challenge levels you will progress on this upgrade track, completing the track will unlock extra levels and extra Medals for completing Challenge levels. 
[url=https://i.imgur.com/1OQlEsZ.png][img]https://i.imgur.com/1OQlEsZ.png[/img][/url]
The progress in this track is added retroactively from your previously completed levels.

To earn even more Medals, the Quest rewards and Weekly tasks will now award more of them.


[h2]Each day is a new bonus[/h2]
Once the Daily Bonus upgrade is unlocked, you will start receiving a passive bonus, this bonus changes with each day. So if you're going for a certain achievement and could use a little bit of help - make sure to catch the discount bonus days!
[url=https://i.imgur.com/PJiN16I.png][img]https://i.imgur.com/PJiN16I.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Master the Masteries[/h2]
After achieving the rank of 1. Dan or above from achievements, you will start earning Mastery points, these will be used for different Mastery tracks to further boost your power. [i]Note that you won't be able to unlock all of the Mastery upgrades![/i]
[url=https://i.imgur.com/MPoDo4G.png][img]https://i.imgur.com/MPoDo4G.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Sharpen your mind[/h2]
Another small, fun activity is being introduced - Weekly Riddles. Each week a unique riddle will be presented for everyone, solve it and be reward with a sum of Amber.
[url=https://i.imgur.com/FJawwe4.png][img]https://i.imgur.com/FJawwe4.png[/img][/url]

[h2]New goals[/h2]
To benefit from these new bonuses, more content is being added for the end-game!
● New unlockable Building - Academy
● Uprade Tier 14
● New Ascension skills
● New Achievements


[h2]Pets, pets and pets[/h2]
Three new Pets are being introduced with this update
● Frog - the master of Fireflies, boost their gains and catch them automatically
● Turtle - the wise hermit, boost the away income while gaining discounts with Gold
● Dragonling - the gracious being, boost your Coin gains and the Firefly luck

To speed up the bonding times a new consumable is being introduced - Pet Treats. Pets that have this treat active will receive bonding progress even if they are not by your side, while if they are, the bonding progress is doubled!

The Pet Star upgrade costs have always been slightly ridiculous, so with this update the costs and how many Stars you receive from double summons has been changed - costs are reduced for later levels and increased for early levels

[h2]Legacy achievements[/h2]
With this update a couple of harder Achievements will reward unique Legacy Achievements, this is to show your dedication before they become easier to earn. Unlocking these Achievements after the update won't reward appropriate Legacy Achievements.
These Achievements will include:
- Big Brain Move (Tier 11)
- The Pen is Mightier than the Hammer (Tier 7)
- 6. Dan



[i]This is a beta test so please share your thoughts on what should be re-balanced or re-checked, how should Medal upgrades be distributed? Should any of them be switched around?

Read the full change log inside the game through the version history found in the Settings tab.[/i]

notes.title: A few words about the recent changes & Tap Ninja v5.0.2 is live!
notes.notes:
You've probably noticed that the game has received some balancing changes.

Some of you might have questions about why even do a full rebalance, or, in other words, "Why destroy the game?" - Simply put, the problem was with the way Elixir was acquired. The best strategy to gain the most Elixir was to Ascend, play for a minute, Ascend, play for a minute, and repeat. It's nice for players who have figured it out and actually enjoy doing that, but it's awful for everyone else. So it was changed for Elixir to be gained mostly from longer runs by tying the gained Elixir to the Coins value, by doing that, most of the game had to be rebalanced to fit the new system.
Another shortcoming I wanted to tackle was the awful offline gains, those were massively boosted, but at the same time, the active play gains were nerfed.

In making both of these changes, I messed up the game too much. The active play gains have been nerfed, they have been nerfed too far.

So now come the hotfix updates, as I want to make the game feel right for everyone. I am still working on getting the balancing right, so please be patient while I'm working on it, as there will be more changes and boosts coming. I am reading all of your comments, and I want to make the game fun for everyone.

Thank you to everyone who is sharing actual usable feedback on what you don't enjoy about the new changes and suggestions about what needs fixing.



[b]The v5.0.2 changelog[/b]

● Further balancing changes that mostly buffed active play upgrades
● Fixed a bug with Firefly events having no effect after challenges
● The stashed Old rewards and the New rewards now correctly display the total count

notes.title: Upcoming v5.0.0 update news & Beta test
notes.notes:
If everything goes correctly then the update will be released on 27th September, this year.


[h1]v5.0.0 is landing in the public beta test![/h1]
Anyone that is playing on a Steam client can join. Read the instructions on how to join over here - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1891700/discussions/0/3316358999124492855/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/1891700/discussions/0/3316358999124492855/[/url]

[i]Your main games save file will not be affected while playing the beta, and the beta save file will be deleted once the beta ends.[/i]

[b]More idle - more fun[/b]
With the new update the game will receive a full rebalance to be more idle-friendly – Away income will receive a massive boost and will now be comparable to active play in the later game, Daily Quest rewards and Challenge rewards will receive a huge boost as well.
The Elixir will be changed as well – receiving it passively from Gold is no longer a thing, now its value is tied to the Coins value and is mainly obtained from defeating Enemies.

[b]Rebalanced all the way[/b]
Every upgrade in the game has been rebalanced in a way. The Ascension tree skills as well as the Medal Upgrades have been reorganized and moved around with numerous Medal upgrade ranks being added (do not worry, everyone will get a free reset!). So please take your time to get used to the new changes.
Most of the upgrades are now multiplicative instead of additive, meaning that what you see is what you get regarding the bonus.

[b]Walking Zoo[/b]
Another big addition is the ability to select two additional Pets at a time! Unlocking either slot requires treating your Pets with love and raising their Bond levels to a certain level. 

Every single Pet now matters – each pet’s passive boost is now active at all times, but only the selected active Pets will grant their full potential. Remember that the passive boost is stronger the higher the Pets Bond and Star level is. The maximum Bond level has also been raised from 12 to 15, so your favourite Pets can become even stronger!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4lCr4Wd.png[/img]

This is a beta test so please share your thoughts on what should be re-balanced or re-checked, how should Medal upgrades be distributed? Should any of them be switched around?

[i]Opening the update for the first time will convert your old Elixir values and Godai element levels to the new ones
Read the full change log inside the game through the version history found in the Settings tab.[/i]

notes.title: Upcoming Pet update news & Beta test
notes.notes:
The Pet update will be released in 14 to 18 day time from now.

The update is being tested in a public beta test, anyone that is playing on a Steam client can join. Read the instructions on how to join over here - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1891700/discussions/0/3316358999124492855/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/1891700/discussions/0/3316358999124492855/[/url]


First of all the Stars from Challenges will be swapped to Medals.

[b]What are Pets?[/b]
At launch there is going to be 12 different pets, each with their own abilities, passive bonuses, a Star level and a Bond level.
While both Star and Bond levels increase the Pets passive bonus, the abilities will be unlocked once the Pet reaches a certain Star level.
There are three types of Pets – Critters, Beasts and Birds. Each type has a unique passive bonus.
You will be able to select one Pet at a time to follow you and help on your journey.
And yes - you can name your pets.

[b]How to obtain Pets?[/b]
Pets will be obtainable though a new currency – Eggs. 
Opening these Eggs will have a chance obtain a stronger or a weaker pet.
Obtaining a weaker pet will award you with another new currency - Critter Stars, Beast Stars and Bird Stars. The Star type that you earn will depend on the Pets type.

[b]How to strengthen the Star level?[/b]
While obtaining a stronger pet though Eggs will automatically increase that Pets star level, you can also collect enough Stars of the appropriate type and upgrade the Star level for a pet of your own choosing.

[b]How to strengthen the Bond level?[/b]
To increase the Bond level you have to keep the Pet by your side and bonding with it though your journeys, this will gradually fill up your pets bond meter and once it’s full you can spend Medals from Challenge levels to advance the pet to the next Bond level.


[url=https://i.imgur.com/XeV26NY.png][img]https://i.imgur.com/XeV26NY.png[/img][/url]
The Pet Collection



Swapping between pets is only doable once per day to avoid any unnecessary power gaming.

[i]The beta focuses on pet functionality and testing if the abilities work correctly

Note that all of the pet Star costs and Bond level timers have been drastically reduced so that later Pet level abilities can be tested.[/i]

notes.title: Suggestions for the Pet update
notes.notes:
Greetings!

The pet update is coming along nicely and I expect it to be done sometime in the first part of October.

Here is some basics on how the pets will benefit you:
[list]
[*] Each pet will have a different benefits - one could make the fireflies appear more often while another one would reduce the cost of buildings.
[*] Pets will also have levels, these would either boost their primary benefit or unlock a new one.
[*] You will be able to choose one to help and fight by your side
[/list]
So now I want to hear your suggestions on what kind of Pets would you like to see and what would be their ability to focus on.

[i]Here is an example[/i]
Snake - based around the Rope Hook
Lvl 1: Increases Rope Hooks length by x
Lvl 2: Decreases Rope Hooks cooldown by x
Lvl 3: Each Critical hit takes away 1 second from the current Rope Hooks cooldown
Lvl 4: Rope Hook can now penetrate one enemy

Thanks everyone!
